brandStory.title: A fragrance. An identity.
brandStory.p1: At GAMOUZE, we believe that a perfume is far more than a simple beauty gesture. It is your first greeting and your lingering trail — a second skin whispering who you truly are.
brandStory.p2: Each of our flacons is born from relentless devotion to noble raw materials: pure sacred oud, precious rose petals, warm amber, and vibrant citrus, harmonized for lasting distinction.

about.title: A fragrance. An identity.
about.subtitle: Moroccan olfactory excellence meeting timeless oriental traditions and contemporary Parisian flair.
about.storyTitle: The Art of Leaving Your Mark
about.storyP1: Founded on the desire to deliver an uncompromising perfumery experience, GAMOUZE elevates personal expression through audacious and memorable accords. To us, perfume is no fleeting novelty: it is the very essence of your aura, the invisible yet everlasting imprint of your presence.
about.storyP2: We meticulously curate the world's most precious essences — purest Cambodian agarwood, hand-harvested Damascena rose, golden amber, and Mediterranean sun-drenched bergamot. Each creation guarantees exceptional projection and persistence.
about.artisanatDesc: All our creations are developed as potent Extraits and intense Eaux de Parfum ensuring continuous diffusion from dawn to dusk.
about.ingredientsDesc: Every essence originates from sustainable, noble terroirs ensuring unblemished purity and optimal skin affinity.
about.serviceDesc: Personalized guidance through our private WhatsApp salon to assist you in discovering your signature scent.
